content.thinking:
I'm now putting together the structured output for this Chinese delivery note from Dongguan Precision Housings, number SN-261008-884, dated 2026-10-08, going to Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg with no PO. The line is a pre-order GH6 enamel pin, 30 pieces packed into 15 packages, and I'm working through the gross weight next.

I'm weighing whether the quantity of 30.000 means 30 pieces or 30,000, since the Chinese decimal convention points to 30 but the 315 kg total across 15 packages would only fit with tens of thousands of tiny pins. I'll record it as written and flag the ambiguity.

Now I'm mapping the date fields: the red receiving stamp gives the received date of 11.11.2026, and the printed note date of 2026-10-08 goes under the shipped date. There's no PO number on this note, so that's a flag to raise.

I'm settling on how to record the material ID and which stamp or signature details belong in the observations, and I'm leaving corrections and decisions empty since the received stamp only confirms receipt. I'll mark the status as having warnings because of the missing PO number and the quantity format ambiguity.

verdict.summary_en: Chinese-language delivery note SN-261008-884 dated 2026-10-08 from Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg for one line: PRM-GH6-PIN, Pre-order Pin "GH6" (enamel), quantity 30.000 PCS, 15 packages, gross weight 315 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. The shipper's seal is on it. It carries a blue DC-HAM receiving stamp dated 11.11.2026 and a handwritten signature "Meyer K.". There are no handwritten corrections. The purchase order field is blank ("—").
red_flags: Purchase order field (采购订单) is blank ("—"), so the delivery cannot be matched to a PO from this document.

Quantity "30.000" is ambiguous: read by the Chinese/English decimal convention it is 30 PCS, but read as a thousands separator it would be 30,000 PCS. The 315 kg gross weight over 15 packages (21 kg each) does not settle which it is. Check the quantity against the order.
The item is described as a "Pre-order Pin" and has no PO reference.
The receiving stamp only records receipt on 11.11.2026. It gives no received quantity and no inspection or acceptance result.
observations: The red shipper seal overlaps the 单位 (unit) and 件数 (packages) column headers and the area around the '15' value. 'PCS' and '15' are still readable.
The signature "Meyer K." is handwritten in blue ink on the 收货签字 (receiving signature) line.
The blue rectangular stamp reads 'RECEIVED 11.11.2026 / DC-HAM'.
The remarks field (备注) is empty.
Scan is slightly skewed, and the lower half of the page is blank.
PRM-GH6-PIN is the 物料号 (material number) on the note. It is not in the buyer's usual CMP- format, so it may be the supplier's own number.
